title: Buckle a baby doll into an infant car seat
instruction: Buckle the baby doll into the car seat.
context: A real infant harness needs correct flat, untwisted shoulder routing and a snug shoulder pinch-and-slide assessment, beyond fastening hardware and placing the chest clip. This scaled practice fixture checks routing and measured adjustment with an explicit fixed-endpoint shoulder geometry assay; its equivalence to a human whole-harness pinch result is unvalidated.
setup: Left and right are the robot's. Positions are in metres from the midpoint between the two arm bases: x forward, y to the robot's left; heights are above the table top. Rear-facing infant carrier, fixed to the table, on a black plastic base: a dark grey plastic shell 38.5 cm long, 27 cm wide, 5 cm deep inside, with a light grey fabric cushion and a black carry handle folded back behind the head end. Its backrest rises 30 degrees from the table, away from the robot, and passes (0.19, 0) 6 cm up. Backrest coordinates start there: u runs up the backrest, v points to the robot's left and w points out of the cushion. A training doll, 34.78 cm along the backrest, 23.00 cm wide and 10.40 cm deep, vinyl and a yellow cloth onesie, fixed in the shell, head away from the robot: its armpits are the mark. Crotch buckle: black plastic with a red button, 4 x 6.8 x 2.6 cm, on a short stalk between the doll's legs, its top 8.8 cm up at (0.16, 0), with two slots facing up, each 1.2 x 2.8 cm and 2 cm deep. Two navy webbing straps, 2.2 cm wide, each from a slot beside the doll's shoulder, 18 cm up at about (0.30, +-0.035), to a tongue: a black plastic body 1.6 x 2.2 x 2.4 cm with a steel blade 2.2 cm long below it. Each tongue starts with its blade in a pocket beside the doll's hip, at (0.200, +-0.085), the pocket's top 10.2 cm up. A red plastic chest clip in two halves, each 2.4 x 2.4 x 1.4 cm, over the doll's belly with 2.7 cm between them. Both arms start at the harness's ready pose with their grippers open. Real harness reference: intact Graco SnugRide 35 Lite LX, manual NWL0000993719A section 4-C, fitted to a 50 cm practice doll in thin clothing. Establish a snug, flat reference on both shoulders by the manufacturer's pinch assessment, mark each shoulder strap at the shell exit, then feed 25 mm additional material through each exit. The front adjustment tail starts at its reset mark and its tab is at (0.060, 0), 8.0 cm above the table, clear of the foot rim; its visible free webbing joins the front exit at (0.100, 0), 8.0 cm up. The simulated carrier is a scaled training fixture, not a dimensionally exact product replica; its shoulder and lap ribbon paths have visible material folds and independently movable shoulder sections. The complete upper-plus-lap material length on each side is fixed at the final fitted reference length plus 25 mm, independently of the open pocket pose. Open tongues use part of that material; remaining excess is visible in the shoulder fold. The 50 cm real reference doll is not the same dimensions as the simulated training mesh (length ratio approximately 0.696).
scoring: 0 at any moment, latched for the trial: the seat moves more than 2 cm or tilts more than 5 degrees, or a fingertip comes within 1 cm of the doll's head. A material overdraw above 1 mm permanently caps the trial at 0.75, preserving lower hardware-stage scores: measured tail feed may not consume material needed for either tongue's independently computed fitted upper-plus-lap route. Otherwise by final state: 0 no tongue latched; 0.25 exactly one tongue; 0.5 both tongues, clip open; 0.75 both tongues and clip closed but any full-score condition fails. 1.0 requires both tongues latched, clip centre within 2 cm of the armpit line, each shoulder and chest strap on its own side with correct routing and no material half-turn, both lap branches on the corresponding hip, and both shoulder material assessments passed. Every point of the displayed shoulder/chest mesh, including face interiors and width edges, must have a conservatively bounded signed Euclidean distance from the doll surface between -2 mm (penetration) and +4 mm. Suspended straight webbing and webbing pushed through the body fail. The signed shoulder width direction stays within 30 degrees of the backrest +v axis and does not reverse; the shoulder corridor is 12 to 14.5 cm up the backrest and 1.5 to 6 cm on its own side of the midline, including width edges. Every chest width edge stays at least 9 mm from the midline on its own side. Each lap branch reaches its own hip and actual tongue anchor within 3 mm, and all its width edges stay at least 3 mm from the midline on that side. These routing distances are scaled training-fixture criteria, not manufacturer fitting thresholds. The local shoulder assay fixes the actual end sections at u=14 and 12 cm, a 20 mm u projection, and excludes material entering from outside. Every longitudinal material lane of the actual triangles, including between mesh columns, must have a conservative (L-D)/2 overlap bound below 2 mm, where L is its measured material length and D its own endpoint chord. This certifies only an inability to form two parallel opposite layers in that clamped window. A constructed length-preserving U candidate with 0.5 mm bend radius and finite 6 by 4 mm pad faces can show overlapping layers; both a fold witness and an indeterminate result fail. Pads are 2 mm thick, align with opposed layer normals (signed dot <= -0.99), and allow 0.25 mm geometric contact tolerance. A chosen fitted-body route is only a reference, not a shortest-path lower bound. Whole-harness material migration, woven shear/bending and thumb-and-finger friction or retention are not established by this assay; no equivalence to the manufacturer's real pinch test is claimed. Each side's measured upper-plus-lap material length must match the fixed starting budget minus physically measured feed within 0.5 mm; flattening a loose fold cannot delete material. The front adjustment tab must be released, with fingertips at least 3 cm from it. All fingertips must be at least 5 cm from the seat and doll and the complete last 1 s range of clip motion below 5 mm, held for 1 s. Checks are evaluated again at the end, not remembered from an earlier good state. Possible scores: 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0.
fidelity: Rigid hardware and kinematic ribbons follow measured joints. Fitting reads actual geometry and conserved material. The local shoulder assay fixes end sections, excludes outside feed, and uses a chord bound or a length-preserving U/pad candidate. It does not model woven shear, bending, contact dynamics or finger friction. Whole-harness migration and real pinch-test equivalence are unvalidated. Only tongues, clip, tail and shoulder patches collide. Not a safety certification.
reset_notes: Use the same reference carrier and practice doll. Refit both shoulder straps flat and untwisted through the slot row at or just below the shoulders, verify the manufacturer's pinch test on both sides, mark each shoulder exit, then release the buckle/clip and draw 25 mm excess webbing per side. Reset the front adjustment tail and put the tongues in their hip pockets.
